questions.stem_text: What does Freud claim to be the main function of dreams? How is this function fulfilled?

options.A: Dreams serve no real purpose and are random firings of the brain during sleep
options.B: Dreams are a manifestation of our subconscious fears and anxieties
options.C: Dreams are the mind's way to rehearse responses to threatening situations
options.D: Dreams are a response to our physical body needs
options.E: Dreams are the brain's method of organizing and storing memories

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Dreams serve no real purpose and are random firings of the brain during sleep

questions.stem_text:
In learned helplessness research, it was found that giving solvable problems eliminated
the helplessness caused by unsolvable problems. It is argued thar this is due to

options.A: the shift in locus of control from internal to external
options.B: a reduction in stress levels caused by the presence of solvable problems
options.C: the application of a continuous reinforcement schedule
options.E: a boost in self-confidence after solving problems

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - the shift in locus of control from internal to external
